priorities.summary: Missing authentication on the Node-RED HTTP interface in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (below V4.3.4.1) lets an unauthenticated remote attacker create malicious flows and execute arbitrary code with maximum privileges. VulnCheck warned on November 2 that exploitation in the wild began on October 30; update to V4.3.4.1 and do not expose Node-RED interfaces to the internet.

A remote OS command injection flaw in the WireGuard CLI Group Handler of WAVLINK WN536AX6-A firmware V260507_2.0.0 lets an attacker manipulate the group_name argument to execute commands on the router. A proof of concept has been publicly disclosed; the vendor was contacted early about the disclosure.

A remote OS command injection flaw in the openvpn_cli handler of WAVLINK WN536AX6-A firmware V260507 lets an attacker manipulate the file_id argument in /protocol.csp to execute commands on the router. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be used; the vendor was contacted early about the disclosure.

model.name: Hydrogen-1.0
model.summary: Deep Principle released Hydrogen-1.0 on November 2, a 753-billion-parameter open-weight model for chemistry, materials science and life sciences, built by post-training Z.ai's GLM-5.3 on domain data, laboratory records and discovery trajectories. Its MIT-licensed weights are on Hugging Face, and the company reports 38.3% on FrontierScience-Research against 33.3% for GPT-6-Astra, though full training data and recipes were not released.
